requirements.title: Task scope closure
requirements.description: Keep objective, exact scope, forbidden boundaries and evidence ceiling current.
requirements.fullText: Before material work bind objective, exact/contingency/forbidden paths, producer and direct consumers, validation and evidence ceiling. Unknown impact does not silently narrow scope.

requirements.title: Final output completeness
requirements.description: Final delivery states the accepted current result, evidence ceiling, material limitations and unique next action.
requirements.fullText: Before final output compare the actual result and claims with the user request and selected requirements. Missing required work is completed when safe or returned as the exact blocker; MISSING/NOT_DELIVERED is not completion.
